main_text.p: Imperator creatus fuit; qvi universam penè Europam, Germaniam, Panno-niam, Gallia & Italiam; Pannoniam, Galliam & Italiam, partim in Societatem suam traxit, partim armorum terrore perculit; in-primis verò fortissimas gentes & Romano nomini infestissimas, Gothos, Gepidas, Longobardos, Herulos[?], in castra sua pertraxit. Inde propter uni-versalem vastitatem terrarum & internecionem dictus est: Flagellum Dei, & terror orbis. Victus est atroci prælio in campis Galliæ Catalannicis[?], & paulò post profluvio Sangvinis ex-tinctus universam Galliam terrore armorum suorum liberavit.
main_text.head: Periodus II.
Canon.
main_text.p: Hunni ex Europa in Asi-am repulsi.
Occasio fuit mors Attilæ; causa im-pulsivæ dissidium inter tres filios At-tilæ;repel-luntur

page.notes: The page number reads "63", printed with a 3 whose shape is uncertain. Italic and roman distinctions in the short phrases "Occasio" and "causa im-pulsivæ" are uncertain. The marginal note beside the last paragraph reads "repel-luntur" in the margin at the foot.
